title: Session data: are we duplicating the raw session files, and where the stray folders go

chat.text: A script hashes every place our logs store your prompt text and counts how much of it is a verbatim copy of the Claude session file on this machine. Records stay, duplicate writers get a deep link instead of a copy, and the answer comes to you as an inbox note. Also decides the two stray locations seen today (an old-style day folder and test logs under public/ai) without deleting anything.
